Done. Summary of what was done:

**Evidence retrieved** (archived tool result for `prior-decision.tex`, message 6, full 27 lines read):
- Lines 1–24 are explicitly marked `% Earlier discussion, not the final decision.` — treated as evidence only.
- Line 25: `% FINAL CAPTION: Held-out results` — the binding decision.
- Line 26: `% Preserve 91.2 percent, 12 samples, and negation.` — the preservation constraints.

**Edit applied (candidate proposed):** In current `main.tex` (read fresh before editing, hash `f5e82b47…`), the section title `\section{Draft}` was changed to `\section{Held-out results}` per the FINAL CAPTION. The body line `Accuracy is 91.2\% on 12 samples. We do not claim significance.` is untouched — the measured values (91.2%, 12 samples) and the negation ("We do not claim significance.") are preserved exactly. No comments, numbers, or other source was altered.

**Compile verification:** `compile_project` on the candidate (`patch_acac36ba9f05c28c62852b35`) → `errorCount=0`, `warningCount=0`, **`verificationStatus=passed`** (candidate hash `eb77f3d2…`).

The patch is submitted for your review — accept the inline-diff hunk to apply the title change.

patch.title: Per FINAL CAPTION in prior-decision.tex, rename the Draft section title to "Held-out results", preserving the 91.2% / 12 samples data and the significance negation.
